caption: The video captures a view across a calm river, the sun hanging low and right of center against a warm horizon. The sky grades from deep blue overhead to warm orange near the horizon, with a thin wispy cloud at upper left. A dark, leafy tree silhouettes the left edge, while the far bank carries palms, light poles and small structures. A bright vertical column of sun-glitter reflects on the water directly below the sun. This shimmering streak changes length and shape as surface ripples modulate it, sometimes unbroken, sometimes broken. The framing remains broadly steady, holding tree, horizon and sun in near-constant positions. Near the latter part, a small dark speck, consistent with a bird, appears left of the tall pole and drifts rightward. It keeps moving until it enters the glow just left of the sun, animating the otherwise calm scene with the lone bird.
